critique: The monumental coral-and-cream woven tower against the pale sky, punctuated by the child’s electric-blue coat and warm internal light, delivers a bold, high-key contrast with a compelling sense of impossible scale. Yet the generic sliding bands and drifting ellipses merely overlay the photograph rather than inventing an unfamiliar motion grammar, while the 16-pixel guinea pig is reduced to an illegible token instead of becoming a surprising compositional agent.
